result.title: Physical-Variable-Informed Deep Learning for Robust Diagnosis in Industrial Fluid Transport Systems
result.summary: Industrial fluid transport systems are monitored through heterogeneous sensing streams, but robust fault diagnosis remains difficult because response signals vary with operating conditions and differ from physical variables in sampling rate, observation duration and data granularity. To address these challenges, we propose a physical-variable-informed deep learning framework (PhyNet) for robust fault diagnosis under real-world sampling heterogeneity. PhyNet treats physical variables as global operating constraints and response signals as local diagnostic evidence. Its physical-to-response cross-attention mechanism connects sequence-level physical-variable tokens with a learnable global response token, enabling interaction without strict temporal alignment. Across four benchmarks, including three real-world cavitation datasets and one public two-phase-flow dataset, PhyNet achieves the best performance across all evaluated metrics. Class-wise analyses, together with attention and masking analyses, show improved discrimination of ambiguous states and indicate that physical variables meaningfully constrain local response interpretation. These findings demonstrate a deployment-oriented approach to robust diagnosis in heterogeneous industrial environments.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PhyNet 框架，将物理变量当作全局运行约束、响应信号当作局部诊断证据，用物理到响应的 cross-attention 在无需严格时间对齐的情况下融合采样率与粒度异构的传感流，并在多个工业故障诊断基准上评估，辅以注意力与掩码分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「全局约束 token 通过 cross-attention 调制局部证据」的做法，及用注意力/掩码分析查验约束是否真的被使用，可能为 LVR 中把物理或几何先验注入 latent 状态、以及视觉证据筛选的归因核验提供方法线索，需进一步核查。
